area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: websearch_to_tsquery accepts web-search syntax and raises no syntax error, so raw user input can go to full-text search.

steps.formulation: to_tsquery builds a query from text in which every operator is written out.
steps.quote: The main one is the to_tsquery function that allows to make query with any operation.

criticism.quote: But to make correct query all of the operators should be specified explicitly.

steps.formulation: plainto_tsquery and phraseto_tsquery build a query from plain text, without operators.
steps.quote: postgres has functions like plainto_tsquery and phraseto_tsquery which allow to make tsqueries from strings

criticism.quote: But they are not flexible enough.

steps.formulation: websearch_to_tsquery accepts a web-like syntax and tolerates errors (release 11).
steps.quote: Error-tolerant conversion function with web-like syntax for search query

criticism.quote: Fix websearch_to_tsquery() to properly parse multiple adjacent discarded tokens in quotes
